# KK Studies

> Study stationery shop in Leicester, Leicestershire, England: undated 12-week study planners, revision cards on binder rings, recycled card desk organisers and pastel highlighter sets. Posts to UK addresses only. Contact: shop@kkstudies.com

## Products and prices (GBP)
- 12-week study planner: £14
- Revision cards, 300 with rings: £9
- Desk organiser: £18
- Highlighter set of 8: £7
- Exam-season bundle: £39
